classification_against_pr152.detail: pr152 checker requires the substring NO_DIRECT_SCALAR_REGRESSION and pre-selects candidate T_A; T_B1, T_B2 and T_C are unrepresentable under it
six control names present; minimum_effect_threshold null; no failing outcome attached to any of them
flag present, root null, no procedure

scientific_goal.statement: Predict the query-local latent cellular state associated with a hidden gene, using the remaining observed RNA.
scientific_goal.critical_seam: If the query scalar reaches the teacher's contextual layers, the target is a deterministic function of the hidden count and the objective becomes indirect scalar regression. Withholding must occur before the first attention layer, not after.
scientific_goal.why_the_named_controls_cannot_see_this: A model that recovers the hidden count also beats identity-only, also beats global-context-only, also beats technical-only, and also collapses when the remaining RNA is removed. The four negative controls are individually correct and jointly blind to this specific failure.

view_rule.consequence: student hidden addresses are zeroed and marked invalid; hidden and structurally-unmeasured become indistinguishable

target.formula: zT_ib = LayerNorm(mean over g in B_ib of H^T_ig)

shared_invariants.reused_gradient_chain: FP16_FORWARD -> BACKWARD_AUTOCAST_DISABLED -> UNSCALE -> PROTECTED_GRADIENT_GATE -> OPTIMIZER_STEP_PROVED_BEYOND_DECAY -> ADAM_EXP_AVG_PROVED -> ADAM_EXP_AVG_SQ_PROVED -> EMA_UPDATE -> SUCCESSFUL_PRESENTATION_CURSOR_ADVANCE -> ATOMIC_CHECKPOINT_TELEMETRY_COMMIT

decisions_open.question: Per-cell value-normalization rule handed to the tokenizer
decisions_open.why_first: N_TOTAL_COUNT_INCLUDING_QUERY is the field-standard default and leaks the query scalar into every other token, defeating all four candidates regardless of which is chosen

decisions_open.question: Where the query scalar is withheld from the teacher (this is the target construction)
How query identity is supplied to student/predictor, and to the teacher's query slot
Target read-out and normalization, which determines whether the evaluation metric is bounded
decisions_open.note: A relative-improvement threshold is meaningful only on a metric bounded in the rewarded direction. R1_RAW forces absolute thresholds. R2 and R3 discard a scale whose nature (biology versus sequencing depth) is itself unresolved.

decisions_open.question: Target granularity
decisions_open.note: BLOCK_LEVEL imports the unresolved blocking authority; the 2026-09-16 grid produced no qualified rule

decisions_open.question: Run the pre-training teacher-only within-cell across-query target-variance screen, and at what bar
decisions_open.tested_limitation: Without replicate targets for the same cell and query the screen cannot separate genuine interaction from noise: a pure-noise target also shows a high interaction share. The screen is interpretable only next to the probe score and must never be read alone.

decisions_open.question: Numeric margin for every control
decisions_open.note: Direction and pairing of every control are proposed frozen in this document; only the sizes remain open, and they must be frozen before the first score is inspected

decisions_open.question: Does PR 152 keep query_scalar_teacher as an enforced checker constant
decisions_open.note: As written the constant hard-codes candidate T_A and makes T_B1, T_B2 and T_C unrepresentable

T_A.name: QUERY_VALUE_IN_TEACHER
T_A.teacher_molecular_inputs: Every g in M_i with its normalized value, query included.
T_A.query_identity_supply: Predictor query is the mean of target-gene identity embeddings projected to model width plus a learned block-mask parameter (BlockPredictor).
T_A.contextual_mixing_operation: Teacher self-attention over |M_i| gene tokens plus a cell token; the query value is present before the first attention layer and is therefore smeared across all positions.
T_A.teacher_stop_gradient_boundary: zT detached; teacher parameters requires_grad_(False); optimizer holds online encoder and predictor only; EMA applied after an accepted optimizer step.
T_A.exact_target_construction: zT_ib = LayerNorm((1/|B_ib|) * sum over g in B_ib of H^T_ig)
in_favour: only candidate with an executable reference path today
matches image-JEPA practice where the teacher sees masked patches
against: measures scalar recoverability rather than query-local state
none of the four required controls can detect this failure
the claim would have to be worded as predicting a contextualized encoding of the hidden count

T_B1.name: VALUE_BLIND_QUERY_SLOT__TEACHER_HIDES_QUERY_ONLY
T_B1.teacher_molecular_inputs: Every g in M_i excluding q with its normalized value, plus a query slot token LN(identity_projection(E_id[q]) + m_val) where m_val is one learned vector shared across all addresses and cells and carries no information about x_iq.
T_B1.query_identity_supply: To the teacher through the query slot identity component; to the student and predictor through D3.
T_B1.contextual_mixing_operation: Teacher self-attention over the value-bearing M_i minus q tokens, the value-blind query token, and the cell token.
T_B1.teacher_stop_gradient_boundary: As shared invariants; additionally the teacher-side m_val is updated only by EMA and never by the optimizer directly.
in_favour: most literal realization of the stated goal
teacher advantage over the student is other genes' real values, never the query's
target is asymmetric and non-trivial without being contaminated
against: requires a value-withheld token path in the teacher that does not exist today
target seeded by E_id[q] plus a constant so a larger share of its variance may be address-constant, making control C1 decisive rather than a formality
the teacher hides one gene while the student hides all of H_i, so the target may be systematically too easy to be worth predicting

T_B2.name: VALUE_BLIND_QUERY_SLOT__TEACHER_HIDES_FULL_MASK
T_B2.teacher_molecular_inputs: Every g in V_i = M_i minus H_i with its normalized value, plus the same value-blind query slot token as T_B1.
T_B2.contextual_mixing_operation: Teacher self-attention over the student's own visible set plus the value-blind query token and the cell token.
in_favour: removes teacher/student view asymmetry entirely as a confounder
any student-teacher gap is attributable to capacity and EMA smoothing rather than privileged data
against: target becomes a smoothed function of exactly the student's own inputs, the classic collapse geometry
the student can approach the target by reproducing its own EMA without the target carrying query-local content
control C2 and the pre-training screen are load-bearing and either failing kills this candidate
target moves as H_i is redrawn

T_C.name: BLOCK_NEIGHBOURHOOD_TARGET__WHOLE_BLOCK_VALUES_WITHHELD
T_C.teacher_molecular_inputs: Every g in M_i minus B_ib with its normalized value; every member of the target block supplied as a value-blind slot.
T_C.query_identity_supply: Existing BlockPredictor query geometry, subject to D3.
T_C.contextual_mixing_operation: Teacher self-attention over the value-bearing non-block tokens, the value-blind block slots, and the cell token.
T_C.exact_target_construction: zT_ib = LayerNorm((1/|B_ib|) * sum over g in B_ib of H^T_ig), with the block's scalars absent from the teacher's context
in_favour: keeps the existing block-summary target shape so the existing BlockPredictor query geometry survives
averaging over block members makes the target less noisy than a single address
a correlated partner inside the block is blinded too
against: query-local becomes block-local and a per-address question is no longer answerable
imports the unresolved blocking authority from the exhausted 2026-09-16 nine-cell grid

T_D.name: RESIDUALIZED_TARGET
T_D.teacher_stop_gradient_boundary: As T_A; the fitted map ghat must itself be outside the optimizer's parameter set.
in_favour: keeps T_A's informative target while attempting to strip the leak
against: a nuisance-removal estimator must first report approximately zero on a controlled fixture containing the nuisance structure and zero query-local signal
removing a scalar from a d-vector is complete only in a fitted sense and the teacher's nonlinearity leaves residual leak
must not be selected without both a null fixture and a planted-signal fixture passing

leakage_paths.name: QUERY_SCALAR_INTO_TEACHER_CONTEXTUAL_LAYERS
leakage_paths.detection: static: inspect the teacher's hidden-mask argument, today torch.zeros_like(true_t). dynamic: perturb x_iq alone and require zT to be exactly unchanged under T_B1, T_B2 and T_C
leakage_paths.repair: value-blind query slot withheld before the first attention layer

leakage_paths.name: QUERY_SCALAR_VIA_PER_CELL_VALUE_NORMALIZATION
leakage_paths.mechanism: if the per-cell scale s_i sums over all of M_i then every visible token's normalized value depends on x_iq; dropping the query token does not remove this, and it leaks into the student as well as the teacher
leakage_paths.detection: perturb x_iq and require every other address's normalized value to be bit-identical

leakage_paths.name: MASK_ELIGIBILITY_ENCODING_THE_VALUE
leakage_paths.mechanism: if only detected addresses are eligible to be hidden then the fact that q was hidden implies x_iq greater than zero
leakage_paths.detection: enumerate the eligibility predicate and confirm it reads only declared support
leakage_paths.repair: eligibility depends on declared support alone

leakage_paths.name: SUPPORT_AND_VISIBILITY_STATE_ENCODING
leakage_paths.mechanism: gene_valid = measurement_mask & ~hidden_target_mask makes hidden and structurally-unmeasured indistinguishable; encoding hidden as measured-zero would instead teach the model that hidden means zero
leakage_paths.detection: enumerate the state encoding and check the hidden state carries no value-derived component
leakage_paths.repair: explicit three-state encoding with a constant hidden state

leakage_paths.name: MEASUREMENT_STATE_SHORTCUT
leakage_paths.measured_evidence: in V0 visibility-only predicts Q_DEPTH at about 0.834 and Q_DETECT at about 0.977, while VALUE_ONLY is materially lower
leakage_paths.detection: control C3 including the support-only sub-arm
leakage_paths.repair: depth, detection, operator and source exist only as separate auxiliary outputs from a detached copy of the primary state; never inputs; no auxiliary gradient may reach the primary state

leakage_paths.name: OPERATOR_AND_SOURCE_STRUCTURE
leakage_paths.scale: 42 operators; 46 SEA_AD, 41 HVS and 17 NPH52 donors
leakage_paths.measured_evidence: the molecular increment over context moved from +0.0311 unweighted to +0.1207 under empirical FULL104 weighting
leakage_paths.detection: control C3; every score reported per source
leakage_paths.repair: no operator or source input to the molecular path; source-stratified donor split; per-source reporting, never a pooled number

leakage_paths.name: IDENTITY_SHORTCUT_DIRECT_PARAMETER_SHARING
leakage_paths.mechanism: target identity to predictor query to gradient to online identity table to EMA teacher to future target
leakage_paths.detection: static enumeration of every parameter shared between query construction, online encoder and teacher target generation

leakage_paths.name: IDENTITY_SHORTCUT_TARGET_CARRIES_STABLE_IDENTITY
leakage_paths.mechanism: even with fixed codes H^T_iq is seeded by E_id[q] plus a constant so a large share of target variance may be address-constant
leakage_paths.detection: control C1 re-measured at several training points, plus the pre-training screen
leakage_paths.repair: if identity-only is not clearly beaten the target is redesigned, never the threshold

leakage_paths.name: CORRELATED_PARTNER_AND_COLLISION_LEAKAGE
leakage_paths.measured_evidence: pooled-Pearson partner masking exposure 0.2129 versus uniform 0.1946, i.e. 9.4 percent worse, structural expansion 12.5; donor-recurrent 0.1853, minus 4.8 percent against a required minimum 20 percent reduction; source-balanced recurrent 0.1947; at a 2000-address universe at most 5 of roughly 4 million ordered pairs reach recurrence fraction 0.5
leakage_paths.detection: exposure metric D from the 2026-09-16 contract; collision-unresolved addresses excluded from M_i

leakage_paths.name: POSITIONAL_AND_ORDERING_ARTIFACTS
leakage_paths.mechanism: token order correlated with expression rank, block index, padding position or storage order
leakage_paths.detection: permutation test requiring the target to be invariant to token reordering
leakage_paths.repair: identity is selection_row for cells and canonical address for genes, never block position, shard key or enumeration counter

leakage_paths.name: EMA_TEACHER_MEMORIZATION
leakage_paths.mechanism: the same cell is presented repeatedly under different masks and the target for that cell is stable, so cell-to-target can be memorized without using RNA
leakage_paths.detection: evaluate only on held-out donors; report the train versus held-out gap as a diagnostic
leakage_paths.repair: training-time scores are never quoted as evidence

leakage_paths.name: CROSS_CELL_MIXING_INSIDE_THE_BATCH
leakage_paths.mechanism: batch-level normalization or a cell state pooling across cells lets same-donor neighbours leak
leakage_paths.detection: shuffle batch composition and require bit-identical per-cell outputs
leakage_paths.repair: per-cell normalization only; no BatchNorm; loss reduction algebraically transparent under microbatching and packing

leakage_paths.name: MASK_DEPENDENT_TARGET
leakage_paths.mechanism: the teacher's input depends on H_i so the target moves with the mask draw
leakage_paths.detection: replay the same cell under the same identity key and require the same mask and the same target
leakage_paths.repair: key the mask RNG from scientific identity so repacking cannot change the target

leakage_paths.name: SPLIT_CONTAMINATION_THROUGH_METHOD_DEVELOPMENT
leakage_paths.mechanism: held-out donors that influence any design choice, even a pathology-blind diagnostic one, stop being held out
leakage_paths.detection: freeze the split and the decision rule before scoring any candidate
leakage_paths.repair: direction and pairing of every control frozen now; numeric margins frozen before the first score is inspected, never after

controls.name: IDENTITY_ONLY
controls.condition: Predictor receives the query address code and nothing else from the cell: no visible RNA tokens, no cell state, no measurement channel. Run under both Q1_SHARED_TRAINABLE and Q2_FIXED_CODE.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: The candidate is disqualified if the paired delta S(full) minus S(identity_only) has a confidence interval that includes or lies below zero. It is also disqualified if S(identity_only) alone exceeds the frozen minimum-effect bar the full model must clear, in which case the target is redesigned and the bar is not moved. Q1 is separately disqualified if S(identity_only, Q1) minus S(identity_only, Q2) is materially positive.

controls.name: GLOBAL_CONTEXT_ONLY
controls.condition: Predictor receives a capacity-matched, query-independent pooled cell summary and the query address code, but no token-level access to the visible genes. The pooled summary must be expressive enough to carry the cell-level state; an under-capacity summary always looks worse than full for numerical reasons and can therefore never fire, which would wrongly credit the construction.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: NOT_DISQUALIFYING_BY_DESIGN. Measured on a planted cell-level target this control stays silent, so it cannot falsify query-locality. Its falsifying role is taken by C2B QUERY_EXCHANGEABILITY. It is retained as a diagnostic of token-level necessity only.
controls.what_it_actually_tests: Whether per-address access to the remaining RNA is necessary beyond a fixed-size cell-level summary. It does NOT test query-locality.

controls.name: QUERY_EXCHANGEABILITY
controls.condition: Each query's model is fitted on its own targets, then scored twice on held-out donors: once against its own targets and once against a different query's targets under a fixed, replay-stable derangement. Each query's targets are centred by their own training mean first, so the address main effect cannot carry the comparison.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: The candidate is disqualified if the paired delta S(own_query) minus S(wrong_query) has a confidence interval including zero: asking the wrong query then costs nothing, every query shares one map, and the target carries no cell-by-query structure. This is the falsifying test for query-locality that C2 cannot provide.

controls.name: TECHNICAL_ONLY
controls.condition: Predictor receives only library depth, detection rate, the binary visibility vector, operator ID and source ID, plus the query address code. No RNA values. A required sub-arm gives the binary visibility vector alone. The support projection must likewise be capacity-matched, for the same reason as C2.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: The candidate is disqualified if S(full) minus S(technical_only) has a confidence interval including zero, and separately if the support-only sub-arm approaches the full model. Because visibility-only predicts Q_DETECT at about 0.977 and Q_DEPTH at about 0.834 in V0, bundling visibility with the other channels would hide its individual contribution, so the sub-arm is mandatory.

controls.name: REMAINING_RNA_NECESSITY
controls.condition: Replace visible RNA values with a cell-independent substitute while preserving shape, support pattern, token count, query code and technical channels. C4a within-cell value shuffle (primary, holds depth and detection exactly fixed). C4b across-cell within-donor value swap on matched support. C4c all visible values set to one constant.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: The candidate is disqualified if S(full) minus S(C4a) has a confidence interval including zero: the address-to-value pairing is then unused and the model is not using the remaining RNA as RNA. The same rule applies to S(full) minus S(C4b) at the donor level. Failure to clear zero at C4c is a more severe form of the same failure.
controls.why_c4a_is_primary: It leaves library depth and detection rate exactly unchanged, so any drop is attributable to molecular content rather than a technical side-effect.

controls.name: LEAK_INJECTION
controls.condition: Deliberately reinsert the query's normalized value into the student's context as an extra token and score again.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: If S(leaked) minus S(full) does not have a confidence interval excluding zero and lying above it, the evaluation cannot detect leakage at all. Every negative control is then uninformative and no conclusion may be drawn from any of them. This disqualifies the measurement apparatus rather than the candidate. A control battery with no demonstrated sensitivity is not evidence.

controls.name: DONOR_OR_CELL_KEY_CHEAT
controls.condition: Predictor receives the donor ID or a stable cell key and nothing molecular.
controls.disqualifying_outcome: The candidate is disqualified if S(full) minus S(donor_key_only) is not clearly above zero: the target then encodes donor identity and the donor-held-out claim is void.
controls.required_closure_check: Maintain a seen vector over the evaluation identity space; every selection_row in range filled exactly once, no duplicates, and no held-out donor's cell appearing in training under any relabelling. Verify the mapping against physical block metadata by indexing known rows, not by comparing totals.

controls.name: TARGET_IDENTITY_STRUCTURE_REPORT
controls.condition: Report the identity-only fraction broken out by address frequency, target-block size, source, operator, donor where lawful, and rare-versus-common address strata.

forbidden_inherited_values.note: These are historical mechanics evidence or synthetic fixture values. None is a default and none may be inherited into any current-V5 setting.

owner_decisions_required: D0 choose the per-cell value-normalization rule, because the field-standard default leaks the query scalar into every other token
D1 choose the target construction T_A, T_B1, T_B2 or T_C, optionally with modifier T_D as a diagnostic
D2 choose the teacher context breadth
D3 choose how query identity is supplied to the student and to the teacher's query slot
D4 choose the target read-out, which determines whether the evaluation metric can be bounded
D5 choose address-level or block-level target granularity, noting that block-level imports an unresolved blocking authority
D6 confirm measurement-state channels exist only as separate detached auxiliary outputs, or not at all

D8b confirm the revised control set: C2 demoted to a token-level-necessity diagnostic and C2B QUERY_EXCHANGEABILITY adopted as the falsifying query-locality control, after C2 was measured silent on its own planted failure
D7 decide whether to run the pre-training teacher-only target-variance screen and set its bar
D8 set the numeric margin for every control, before the first score is inspected
D9 decide whether PR 152 keeps query_scalar_teacher as an enforced checker constant or demotes it to a decision field

Separately: freeze the source-stratified donor split, the scientific cell weights, the mask policy, the model geometry, the EMA half-life, the optimizer schedule, the seed and the update budget, none of which this document proposes

control_sensitivity_evidence.method: Small synthetic populations with donors as the clustering unit, per-cell depth, depth-driven detection and missingness, and Poisson counts over a shared latent cell state. A closed-form ridge probe, fitted per query on training donors and scored on held-out donors, with donor-clustered bootstrap intervals on paired deltas. No network is trained.
control_sensitivity_evidence.fires_rule: A negative control FIRES when the paired delta interval includes or lies below zero.
